402280701.text: Qiqi, you can't just drink sugary stuff. I told you how many glasses of water to have a day. Still remember?

402280702.text: One two three four. Two two three four... Um, no...

402280703.text: It's okay! That's what I'm for. Your personal... hydration assistant, hehe! No better time than the present. Here, have some now!

402280704.text: Aww... You really look out for Qiqi, huh, Yaoyao.

402280705.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Perfect timing! What kind of snacks do you like? Salty? Sweet? Let's see what we have...

402280706.text: Paimon's bag is full of snacks too. Pick out whatever you like!

402280707.text: Snacks and toys are meant for sharing. Here.

402280708.text: Oh! This is the toy Auntie Cloud Retainer made for us. She built a lot of fun adeptal arts into it.

402280709.text: After she heard from Master that we were coming to Inazuma, she lectured us all about being safe on our own.

402280710.text: But, she didn't think telling us would be enough, so she made us this mechanism to play with. She said the most effective lessons are the ones combined with fun!

402280711.text: Be home before dark. Tuantuan and Yuegui go together. Qiqi and Yaoyao have to hold hands.

402280712.text: Yep, that's what she said, huh! Nice remembering, Qiqi!

402280713.text: Auntie Cloud Retainer's adeptal arts are amazing! She made a whole domain where our imaginary friends can play. I even got to meet Qiqi's imaginary friend for the first time, too!

402280714.text: She's a cute little finch, just as adorable as Qiqi herself! Her name is Tuantuan.

402280715.text: Qiqi's obsession with finches is suddenly starting to make a lot more sense...

402280716.text: Yuegui... is like the mechanical Yuegui, but different...

402280717.text: Oh, right. Just in case you're confused, Yuegui is also my imaginary friend. It all started after Auntie Cloud Retainer gave me the mechanical Yuegui. We've grown up a lot together since then.

402280718.text: Tuantuan's grown too. She got chubbier, but she can also fly higher.

402280719.text: Aw, that's awesome! Real or imaginary, it's nice to grow up with friends by your side.

402280720.text: Oh, shoot! I almost forgot I'm supposed to be in charge of drinks! I'll be done soon! You guys should try out this mechanism in the meantime.
